hints.title: Fixed Subarray Window
hints.text: Notice that since each target subarray has length exactly 3, we can center our check around each middle index.

hints.title: Integer Multiplication Form
hints.text: Avoid division by checking whether (nums[i - 1] + nums[i + 1]) * 2 equals nums[i].

hints.title: Count Accumulation
hints.text: Traverse i from 1 to n - 2, incrementing the counter whenever the equality holds.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Linear scan checking (nums[i-1] + nums[i+1]) * 2 == nums[i] for every middle index i.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Verifies middle element equality condition using integer cross-multiplication.
